settingsSso.title: Single sign-on
settingsSso.description: SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect for centralised authentication.

upsell.title: Enterprise feature
upsell.body: SSO is available on Enterprise plans. Upgrade to manage identity centrally for your organisation.

settingsSso.idpEntityIdHint: The entity ID from your identity provider's SAML metadata.
settingsSso.certHint: Paste the public certificate from your IdP for signature verification.
settingsSso.secretHint: Leave blank to keep the existing secret.
settingsSso.allowedDomainsHint: Comma-separated list of email domains allowed to sign in via SSO.
settingsSso.autoProvisionHint: Automatically create accounts for users who sign in via SSO for the first time.
settingsSso.spHint: Use these values when configuring your identity provider.
